description: Agent-facing index for the local trading toolset. Source code lives under apps; this manifest is the discovery contract.

tools.purpose: Execute one provider-neutral, budgeted model task through the fixed SiliconFlow profile without granting domain or execution authority.
notes: Reads SILICONFLOW_API_KEY only from the process environment and never returns prompts, credentials, raw response bodies, or reasoning content.
The parsed output is an untrusted proposal with execution_authority=none; the owning domain must validate it before any persistence or queue transition.

tools.purpose: Serve a loopback authenticated HTTP allowlist for tool discovery, RD reads, and explicitly approved J04 autonomy wakeups.
notes: Requires TRADE_OPERATOR_API_TOKEN for all v1 routes and an independent TRADE_OPERATOR_APPROVAL_TOKEN for the only controlled-write route.
Writes sanitized pre/post audit through ops.runtime-store; exposes no exchange, live execution, arbitrary tool, command, path, SQL, promotion, or process-lifecycle route.

tools.purpose: Build the single-entry automation plan and isolate trade, research, review, and catalog jobs.
notes: Planner only; downstream jobs perform their own writes.

job_health_requirements attaches exact named checks, including l2_service:owner_health and l2_watch_consumer:owner_health, to selected jobs; failed checks block only declared consumers, while account reconciliation remains a defense bypass.

tools.purpose: Execute one leased fixed-profile wakeup: ops-only shadow, J06 canary, or J01-J07 full shadow with exchange writes disabled.
notes: shadow_program writes only orchestration observations; catalog_hygiene_canary delegates only J06; full_shadow delegates the fixed J01-J07 owner graph and its declared logical writes.

No profile can enable exchange live writes, real notifications, arbitrary jobs/commands, GC/--yes, or weaker required L2 service and resident-consumer health checks; ops-only commands are bounded to 30 seconds and domain-enabled profiles to 90 seconds.
This remains the reusable one-shot entry beneath trade-flow.program-shadow-supervisor.

tools.purpose: Run the foreground resident shadow cadence with heartbeat-renewed fenced ownership and graceful shutdown drain.
notes: Foreground only; launchd, systemd, Docker, or another external process manager owns restart and process lifetime.

shadow_program keeps J01-J07 disabled with 30-second ops command bounds; full_shadow enables the fixed seven-job graph under 90-second domain command bounds while preserving owner active gates and permanently denying exchange live writes.

catalog_hygiene_canary can run one-shot or on a fenced resident interval up to 86400 seconds: it forces only J06, permits only artifact_catalog writes, and exposes no GC, --yes, arbitrary-root, notification, or live-write authority.
The durable supervisor lease uses heartbeat renewal and fencing tokens; SIGINT/SIGTERM drains the in-flight wakeup before release.
SQLite contention is bounded to a one-second busy window and returns ops_store_busy; every graph result carries a cycle-independent parity hash for Agent/program comparison.

Optional resident parity observation samples owner commands once, independently builds the legacy Agent shadow graph by replaying those exact results, and stores immutable comparison evidence in ops_runtime_store; sequential live-read history remains non-comparable evidence, and launchd deployment remains an operator lifecycle outside this tool surface.

tools.purpose: Expose an explicit MCP allowlist over local owner reads, including L2 retention/reference audit, active service/consumer health, and runtime parity status, plus controlled asynchronous J04 research submission.
notes: Local stdio only; does not listen on the network.
Discovery does not authorize execution of toolset commands.
l2_retention_reference_audit delegates one exact epoch to the Market Data owner CLI and exposes no deletion or GC authority.
l2_retention_reference_audit_page delegates bounded cursor pagination to the same owner and does not produce deletion candidates.
l2_service_health delegates to the L2 owner and exposes no process IDs, paths, or lifecycle authority.

l2_book_watch_consumer_health delegates to the fixed resident consumer owner read and exposes only readiness, baseline identity, aggregate reliability counters, and the latest sanitized failure timestamp/operation/class/attempt.

runtime_parity_status delegates to ops_runtime_store and exposes raw, shared-input-comparable, and legacy-sequential counts plus latest hashes/basis and lease state; it omits holder/process/path/detail and cutover authority.
research_hypothesis_brief renders owner-controlled program memory and planning context without generating or persisting a hypothesis.
Hypothesis contracts are validated and projected by research.strategy-hypothesis-designer before J04 submission.
research_job_submit records ops state and routes execution through the existing J04 supervisor.
No arbitrary command or exchange-write surface is exposed; live writes remain disabled.

tools.purpose: Record and summarize cycle/job/health/notify/domain-message observability, immutable Agent/program runtime parity, and bounded Watch Task lifecycle in ops_runtime_store.
notes: The summary action is read-only and returns ops_summary with stage, domain, message, and attention aggregates.

The parity_status action is read-only and separates raw immutable history, shared-input-comparable evidence, and legacy sequential live reads while returning compact latest facts plus fenced supervisor lease state without holder identity or cutover authority.
Watch Task actions own definition/state CAS, counters, transitions, and no-authority handoff persistence; they do not evaluate market predicates or execute trades.
Record actions write only ops_runtime_store and never change trade facts.

tools.purpose: Resume one persisted proposed-plan mark-price watch under a fenced lease, then close its typed revalidation receipt without execution authority.
notes: The run action reads only the fixed public symbol-snapshot owner and writes Watch Task lifecycle through ops.runtime-store.
The revalidate action delegates to the fixed watch-handoff revalidation owner, then persists its no-authority receipt/outcome under the same fenced task lease.
It never calls execution-router, live-small runner, event-store, or exchange write.

tools.purpose: Run control tower pre_cycle/pre_job runtime health checks and record the observation in ops_runtime_store.
notes: Lifecycle processor for control tower readiness; not a domain job ticket.
require_l2_ready=true delegates to the registered market-data.l2-service-health owner read and persists only a bounded path/PID-free evidence projection.

require_l2_watch_consumer_ready=true delegates to the registered ops.l2-book-watch-consumer owner read and persists only readiness, epoch/hash/timestamps, bounded reliability counters, and any latest sanitized failure projection.
Both L2 readiness checks are independently opt-in and provide no start, stop, restart, signal, or other lifecycle authority.
Writes logical store ops_runtime_store; toolset legacy writes fields do not yet model ops stores.

tools.purpose: Require active L2 owner health, then return one same-epoch bounded current-book and exact-decimal microstructure observation for non-economic diagnostics.
notes: Calls only registered owner tools: market-data.l2-service-health first, then market-data.l2-current-book.
Requires healthy/overall_ready and exact symbol/stream_epoch agreement; failures close before returning an observation.
Derives spread and depth imbalance with BigInt decimal arithmetic and explicit scaled units; economic authority remains none.
Purely programmatic and non-economic; Agent, LLM, MCP, broker, strategy, and execution are not dependencies.

tools.purpose: Require active L2 owner health, then observe a bounded same-epoch latest-only watermark watch and surface explicit resync follow-up.
notes: Calls registered market-data.l2-service-health before market-data.l2-book-watch and requires the initial epoch to match.
Watermarks are latest-only/coalescing observations, never depth deltas; resync or rollover requires a new current-book snapshot.
No Agent, LLM, MCP, broker, strategy, execution, lifecycle, or write authority.

tools.purpose: Run a bounded reconnecting L2 observation session with mandatory current-book baselines after watch failure, epoch change, or resync.
notes: Composes only the registered read-only L2 health, current-book, and watch owner paths through their validated probes.
Uses owner-fixed bounded exponential retry delays and requires a fresh snapshot after watch failure, epoch change, or resync.
Returns bounded transition and aggregate reliability evidence without retaining endpoint, path, PID, subprocess error, depth delta, or durable delivery state.
No Agent, LLM, MCP, broker, strategy, execution, lifecycle, or write authority.

tools.purpose: Read the fixed health, latest current-book baseline, and aggregate reliability counters of the unique resident L2 watch consumer.
notes: Reads one atomic latest projection from the unique operator-launched supervisor/worker without exposing PID, path, endpoint, subprocess error, or lifecycle command.
The resident worker composes only validated L2 health/current-book/watch owner paths and resnapshots after watch failure, epoch change, or resync.
Metrics are local aggregate observation counters, not depth-delta delivery, durable acknowledgements, Replay evidence, strategy signals, or execution facts.
No Agent, LLM, MCP, broker, trading, execution, lifecycle, or write authority.

tools.purpose: Run control tower post_job/post_cycle notification dispatch and record notify_attempt rows in ops_runtime_store.
notes: Lifecycle processor for control tower closeout; not a domain job ticket.
Writes logical store ops_runtime_store; dry-run and stdout channels are deterministic local adapters.

tools.purpose: Run post_cycle control-system effectiveness review over incidents, job failures, and notify failures; persist improvement items in ops_runtime_store.
notes: Lifecycle processor for control tower closeout; it diagnoses control-system failures but does not modify code, config, or trade facts.
Writes logical store ops_runtime_store.control_review only.

tools.purpose: Initialize and append local plan_event records, reduce flow state, and dry-run slow or fast tracks.
notes: Use --track for dry-run only; append commands write local events.

tools.purpose: Own local trade event schema, append semantics, chain scans, and latest order-fill reads.
notes: Only owner of plan_event append semantics; outside-domain callers must use this owner CLI or protocol bus.

tools.purpose: Own rebuildable flow and account-scoped portfolio projections derived from plan_event.
notes: Projection reads are rebuildable; approved reconcile writes still go through event-store append semantics.

tools.purpose: Run native J02 fast_track_guard over active flows and return a domain-runtime job result.
notes: J02 owner handler. Writes fast observe facts and fast-track artifact only; never calls exchange write tools.
Returns a domain-runtime job result owned by live-execution-control.

tools.purpose: Rank already-qualified setup versions and produce one account-scoped, self-hashed risk-unit allocation proposal.
notes: Consumes owner-qualified candidates and exact strategy/plan/market-fact hashes; never turns scan scores into setups.
Uses integer risk units and rejects rather than partially resizing; output is proposal-only with no capital reservation or execution authority.

tools.purpose: Load runtime inputs, call read-only snapshot tools, and build normalized observe events.
notes: Observation builds facts for downstream flow steps; it does not decide or execute actions.

tools.purpose: Call read-only exchange projection tools and normalize account/market responses for observe candidates.
notes: Read-only snapshot projection; no trade DB, execution, or exchange write ownership.

tools.purpose: Build normalized observe event candidates from supplied account, market, plan, and policy projections.
notes: Builds an observe candidate only; persistence and execution gating remain outside this owner.

tools.purpose: Own read-only J03 planning and emit DecisionInputBundle, TradePlanDraft, unallocated CapitalAllocationProposal, and blocked ActionIntent without live execution.
notes: Writes only an ephemeral decision artifact; it does not append trade events, allocate capital, approve a plan, or place exchange orders.

tools.purpose: Assemble policy, market, flow, account, and research refs into one explicit planning input bundle.
notes: Input assembly only; it does not decide, size, execute, or write event facts.

tools.purpose: Build non-executable trade-plan drafts from assembled decision inputs.
notes: Draft planner only; executable authorization starts in live-execution-control.

tools.purpose: Publish trade-plan, watchlist, or no-action decisions as protocol action intent refs.
notes: Decision outbox only; it does not execute or record trade facts.

tools.purpose: Compile one matching plan draft and proposed action intent into a fixed bounded Watch Task definition.
notes: Compilation only; a proposed intent is not execution authorization and the tool does not run or persist tasks.

tools.purpose: Record exchange command/result/snapshot refs in the exchange_runtime_store audit ledger.
notes: Audits exchange side-effect refs only; confirmed money truth is still appended through portfolio-execution-state/event-store.

tools.purpose: Classify exchange requests into read routes or write-gate routes before adapter-specific handling.
notes: Routes only; it does not call Binance, approve risk, or persist exchange runtime state.

tools.purpose: Validate authorized exchange write requests before adapter tools receive them.
notes: Gate only; runtime policy approval remains policy-risk and execution preflight remains live-execution-control.

tools.purpose: Normalize write result and reread confirmation facts into exchange command refs.
notes: Produces exchange command/result refs only; event append remains portfolio-execution-state ownership.

tools.purpose: Record market manifests, typed leased data demands, L2 owner retention/referrer evidence, funding events, feature manifests, instrument-status acquisition receipts/raw payloads, and immutable archives in market_data_store; own canonical candles and immutable candle-slice exports from ohlcv_store.
notes: Owns logical market_data_store refs and ohlcv_store refs; durable market data uses database owner-store contracts, not file directories.
export_candle_slice writes a content-addressed immutable CSV/manifest artifact and returns a slice ref so Research never queries canonical_candle directly.

Read actions include read_manifest, read_funding, read_instrument_status_acquisition_receipt, read_instrument_status_archive, read_feature_manifest, read_feature_artifact, and list_feature_manifests so other domains can consume owner refs without direct table access.

admit_feature_manifest and read_feature_artifact both parse the bounded artifact bytes and close source slice, feature set, symbol, timeframe, and content hash; a path/hash row alone is not owner evidence.

Typed demand put is create-or-renew for one stable semantic identity; renewal may only advance its lease and preserves prior hashes in an audit table. Reconciliation returns a no-authority capacity proposal; callers never control daemon lifecycle.
audit_candle_coverage returns a bounded self-hashed aligned-range projection with exact gap counts; fetch completion alone is not coverage evidence.
L2 retention/reference audit is a self-hashed read projection over registered owner evidence; it never infers deletion eligibility or GC authority.
Audit pagination is owner-ordered and capped at 50 epochs; counts are page-local and cross-call snapshot consistency is not claimed.
Instrument-status acquisitions and archives use immutable create-or-identical CAS; only historical acquisition capability can enter an archive source batch.

tools.purpose: Read one explicitly selected active L2 supervisor, or require global uniqueness when no symbol is supplied, without exposing lifecycle control.
notes: Caller may supply one validated symbol; without it the owner read requires exactly one live repository-owned supervisor and fails closed when ownership is ambiguous.
Combines supervisor state with the fixed loopback Rust health query; returns no PID, runtime path, log path, or lifecycle command.
Health is local operational evidence and does not prove external market-data completeness or economic authority.

tools.purpose: Read one bounded, fresh, hash-verified full-depth snapshot from an explicitly selected L2 owner, or from the globally unique owner when no symbol is supplied.
notes: Caller may select one validated symbol and controls bounded depth / max freshness; without a symbol the read requires one globally unique owner. Endpoint, release query binary, and a 1500ms deadline remain owner-fixed.
Schema, requested/owner symbol, epoch, four timestamps, sorted decimal levels, bounded book hash, continuity, and uncrossed top are validated.
Returns a non-economic bounded-depth snapshot with execution_compatible=false and no lifecycle or trading authority.

tools.purpose: Observe a bounded latest-only L2 watermark stream from an explicitly selected owner, or from the globally unique owner when no symbol is supplied, with explicit timeout, epoch, and resync semantics.
notes: Caller may select one validated symbol and controls only max-events 1..100 and watch-ms 100..5000; without a symbol the read requires one globally unique owner. Endpoint, binary, and deadline overhead are owner-fixed.
Validates watermark identity, time/update monotonicity, epoch rollover, and mandatory resync; slow consumers observe the latest value without ingestion backpressure.
This is not a depth-delta or Replay stream and grants no lifecycle, strategy, trading, or execution authority.

tools.purpose: Normalize one finalized immutable venue status-event archive into hash-bound Replay instrument-status epochs and provenance.
notes: Read-only provider; archive import remains market-data.store ownership.
Does not infer status from missing OHLCV or certify external venue completeness beyond the committed archive finality assertion.

tools.purpose: Validate market data manifests before they are consumed by research, decision, or execution domains.
notes: Gate only; it does not fetch data, compute signals, or write durable market facts.

tools.purpose: Publish market data products as manifest-backed refs for protocol-fabric/event-bus consumption.
notes: Produces market-data manifest refs; durable storage remains owned by market-data.store.

tools.purpose: Record runtime policy snapshots and approved strategy refs, then issue bounded runtime authorizations from the registered snapshot.
notes: Compiler remains pure; registry owns durable policy snapshots and approved refs, and authorization refs are short-lived projections rather than new durable policy facts.

tools.purpose: Compile explicit runtime trading config into normalized policy snapshots without durable writes.
notes: Pure compiler; policy-registry owns durable runtime policy snapshots and approved strategy refs.

tools.purpose: Own durable RD program and Control Plane authority facts, including immutable current-contract Evaluation Work Packages.
notes: Owns durable RD state rows plus immutable Proposal/Brief/Freeze/Trial Plan/Evaluation Work Package/Result authority facts; experiment artifacts remain in artifact/catalog stores.

tools.purpose: Materialize and register one Review-authorized Draft Strategy with deterministic lint and content hash.
notes: Requires accept_for_draft authorization bound to one selected Trial, Candidate, and primary Result.
Does not review evidence or promote beyond draft.

tools.purpose: Publish research, validation, shadow, candidate, and lesson outputs as protocol evidence refs.
notes: Refs-only research outbox boundary; durable artifacts remain owned by artifact catalog modules.

tools.purpose: Run native J07 closed_flow_review_sweep and record review batch refs in governance_ledger.
notes: Returns a domain-runtime job result owned by governance-review-compliance.
Reads trade_event_store and writes governance_ledger review_batch rows; subjective review and trade.db review events remain separate.

tools.purpose: Validate governance evidence refs for freshness, data hash, policy hash, and source refs before review or promotion.
notes: Gate only; accepted or blocked evidence is represented as a governance ref and can be persisted by governance ledger owners.

tools.purpose: Compile review findings into policy feedback refs for policy-risk consumers.
notes: Produces policy feedback refs only; runtime policy changes remain owned by policy-risk.

tools.purpose: Certify compatibility Replay fingerprints for legacy evidence integrity review.
notes: Canonical parity certification over the legacy research kernel; does not run Replay or forward Trial-bound requests.
Kernel retirement must explicitly migrate or terminate this certification; native Replay fingerprints remain Trial-bound authority.

tools.purpose: Compile one hash-locked formal Replay data bundle or execute one immutable Trial-bound Replay request and atomically publish its Result Artifact.
notes: Certified v1 supports one isolated asset lane, next-open market entry, full reduce-only stop/target, exact funding events, and unified evidence ledger.
The separate --compile-data-bundle mode verifies bounded repository-scoped source bytes against one certified Dataset Manifest and grants no execution authority.
Production Attempt leases must be obtained through research.replay-attempt-admission so local cancellation recovery precedes fresh claim.
No Candidate generation, Review Decision, formal Shadow, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Reconcile validated local Replay cancellation outboxes with Control Plane Observation authority before fresh worker admission.
notes: Control Plane-owned startup job; it may append only an exact pending cancellation Observation through the authoritative registry.
Does not run Replay, claim Attempts, delete outboxes, or expose machine-local paths in its result.

tools.purpose: Recover the certified local cancellation outbox set before issuing one authoritative Replay Attempt lease.
notes: Control Plane-owned claim-side gate; complete outbox recovery and authority inspection happen before claimRegisteredReplayAttempt on the same DB session.
Returns Replay Attempt Admission Result v3 with one Registration-bound Dispatch Authority; does not run Replay, spawn workers, delete outboxes, or expose machine-local paths.

tools.purpose: Split source OHLCV manifests into discovery, validation, and locked holdout manifests with embargo.
notes: Pure data governance split; no R&D search, replay, review, trade DB writes, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Bind one discovery or validation split segment to its exact report, manifest, and content hashes without opening locked holdout.
notes: Read-only data-governance proof; rehashes report, manifest, and segment content and rejects locked holdout.

tools.purpose: Evaluate the latest closed-candle signal for one R&D family candidate or compiled strategy contract.
notes: Read-only latest-signal check; no R&D search, catalog write, promotion, trade DB write, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Evaluate one candidate set across a multi-asset panel with panel negative controls and marketability gates.
notes: Panel mode on the candidate-batch owner; no compatibility evaluator remains.
Read-only evaluation; no R&D loop artifact write, RD memory write, strategy promotion, trade DB write, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Render agent-native strategy design prompts, lint structured strategy hypothesis contracts, and project valid designs into RD queue seed items.
notes: This is the agent-native strategy design layer before candidate-batch. It never runs replay or writes strategy policy.
Use --action validate for contract lint and --action queue_item to produce a next_hypothesis_queue seed.

tools.purpose: Initialize, read, update, plan_next, or atomically queue one validated ready proposal in durable R&D learning memory.
notes: Writes the explicit research_state_store rd_program row. plan_next is read-only; queue_proposal is updated_at-CAS protected and accepts only ready proposals.

tools.purpose: Run one bounded J04 wakeup: refill an empty active queue through a validated model proposal, then delegate the existing RD supervisor.
notes: Stopped programs and already-ready plans do not call the model; provider/schema/unready failures write no state and run no Trial.
Queue writes delegate to research.rd-program-state queue_proposal CAS; Trial execution delegates to research.rd-supervisor and promotion remains outside this surface.

tools.purpose: Run native J04 rd_strategy_supervisor, execute one immutable compatibility Evaluation Work Package, prepare or enqueue registered formal Replay data, and run one or residently consume formal Replay jobs from durable RD state.
notes: Orchestrates plan_next, rd-loop-runner / rd-campaign-runner execution, explicit RD state writeback, and optional draft strategy policy creation.

The alternate --evaluation-job mode consumes an owner-compiled Work Package, completes already-reserved Trials, and publishes compatibility_mechanical_replay evidence; it never claims formal Replay authority or permits positive promotion.
The alternate --formal-replay-prepare-job mode binds one exact Developer Data Snapshot to one Registration and delegates immutable bundle compilation to the Replay owner without opening an Attempt.

The alternate --formal-replay-job mode crosses registered Attempt Admission and Replay Execution owner CLIs, then atomically publishes only replay_owner/mechanical_replay evidence; it grants no Review, Registry, Forward, deployment, or trading authority.

The queue modes use immutable work identity and a single fenced active slot. The foreground entry resumes the same generation after process restart and rotates execution identity only after queue-lease expiry; it remains no-live and cannot auto-promote.
Returns a domain-runtime job result owned by research-strategy-development for J04.

tools.purpose: Run a legacy-compatible post-freeze signal diagnostic without claiming Forward Evidence authority.
notes: Compatibility mode on the signal-evaluator owner; no forward-holdout compatibility module remains.
Read-only signal diagnostic. Output may feed rd-shadow-tracker but is not Forward Evidence, strategy evidence, or promotion proof.

tools.purpose: Run canonical J05 R&D paper trackers and project diagnostic entry signals into paper setup event chains.
notes: The legacy tool/job ID is preserved, but the owner is the canonical Forward Evidence paper tracker.
Tracker output is paper review input only, not formal Shadow or strategy evidence. It writes explicit tracker artifacts and catalog refs, never trade.db or exchange state.
Returns a domain-runtime job result owned by research-strategy-development for J05.

tools.purpose: Run a no-backfill post-freeze evidence session for one ready Draft Strategy binding.
notes: Requires strategy_ref, policy hash, Candidate freeze, watermark, and Forward reservation.
Output is RD forward evidence only, never formal Shadow or account execution evidence.

tools.purpose: Evaluate one bounded candidate batch with candidate negative controls and reliability gates.
notes: Read-only candidate evaluation. It does not write R&D artifacts, RD memory, catalog, strategy evidence, trade DB, or exchange state.

tools.purpose: Run one auditable R&D loop iteration with artifact, catalog, ledger, and optional RD state writeback.
notes: Owns one loop artifact writeback. It uses candidate-batch for evaluation and may update RD memory only when rd_program_ref is explicit.

tools.purpose: Run one bounded R&D campaign over a hypothesis queue with discovery, locked validation, artifact writeback, and optional RD state update.
notes: Owns campaign-level gates and orchestration only. It calls rd-loop-runner for discovery/validation loops and candidate-batch-engine for trial counting.

tools.purpose: Check exact funding event coverage before funding-carry research trials.
notes: Read-only data governance check; no R&D search, replay, trade DB writes, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Run one fixed multi-asset trend benchmark for R&D pipeline calibration.
notes: Legacy tool ID for fixed benchmark mode on the canonical Replay calibration certification owner; no compatibility runner remains.
No strategy promotion, R&D search, trade DB writes, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Run fixed calibration diagnostics across buy-hold, trend, and relative-strength baselines.
notes: Runtime-computed diagnostic certification, not a static fixture or promotion decision.
No strategy promotion, R&D search, trade DB writes, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Compile one strategy markdown contract into normalized strategy contract output.
notes: Pure contract compile command; no research search, replay, review, catalog, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Lint one strategy markdown contract for lifecycle and R&D readiness.
notes: Pure contract lint command; no research search, replay, review, catalog, or exchange access.

tools.purpose: Publish and query logical domain inbox/outbox envelopes in ops_runtime_store.
notes: Writes logical bus message rows in ops_runtime_store; payloads remain refs owned by their source domains.

tools.purpose: Append strategy evidence, build review reports, and gate strategy status transitions.
notes: Reads trade.db only when --db is provided. Promotion can update strategy markdown only with explicit --yes where required.

tools.purpose: Reduce local flow state, reconcile against account snapshots, and optionally apply safe local drafts.
notes: Does not call Binance write endpoints.

tools.purpose: Run the audited execution path, record order_fill events, shadow execution, or explicitly authorized live-small entry.
notes: Binance writes require --run-live-small plus --yes and preflight/contract gates.

tools.purpose: Own safe recovery orchestration for a single local flow without exchange writes.
notes: Recovery may append local needs_review/reconcile facts through state owner surfaces; it never places exchange orders.

tools.purpose: Route approved executable target actions to exchange command specs without executing them.
notes: Implements the blueprint execution action router and command compiler boundary; it returns command specs only.

tools.purpose: Evaluate deterministic trigger readiness before an approved action continues toward preflight and command compilation.
notes: Gate only; preflight policy checks and exchange execution are separate owner boundaries.

tools.purpose: Revalidate one triggered Watch handoff against fresh facts, the existing trigger gate, and plan preflight.
notes: A passing receipt still has execution_authority=none and requires a separate explicitly authorized execution path.

tools.purpose: Own dry-run and shadow execution flow transitions, skipped observes, and idempotency gates.
notes: Does not perform live exchange writes; state access goes through portfolio-execution-state owner tools.

tools.purpose: Convert execution tool results into auditable order_fill event drafts without appending them.
notes: Returns event drafts only; persistence belongs to state owner append semantics.

tools.purpose: Own explicitly authorized live-small execution, preflight gate, exchange write command execution, and audited fill append.
notes: Requires explicit --yes and preflight gates before live exchange writes.

tools.purpose: Own artifact catalog surfaces, including the native J06 catalog_hygiene_scan domain job, catalog indexing, stale-ref reports, and explicitly authorized GC.
notes: J06 uses --catalog-hygiene-job and returns a domain-runtime job result owned by artifact-knowledge.
GC is dry-run unless --yes is present.

tools.purpose: Fetch candles into ohlcv_store and market manifests into market_data_store; also supports funding, calibration panels, and market feature inputs.
notes: Writes market data products and manifests, not strategy decisions.

OHLCV fetch defaults to data/market_data.db for manifests and data/ohlcv.db for canonical candles; it reads latest canonical candle per timeframe from ohlcv_store and incrementally upserts candle rows there.
Calibration suite input carries market_data_db, funding_events_ref, and feature_manifest_ref alongside indicator_report_path while downstream readers finish moving to owner read ports.

tools.purpose: Compute indicators, structure, BTC beta, and feature series from local OHLCV manifests.
notes: Pure analytics; no exchange access.

tools.purpose: Evaluate deterministic hard guards and render/validate decision cards.
notes: Verdict only; does not write events.

tools.purpose: Read canonical account facts with stable venue account ref/scope, as-of time, snapshot ref and content hash, while retaining legacy response fields during migration.
notes: Read-only Binance API; credentials never enter the returned account fact.

tools.purpose: Read one symbol's ticker, mark price, funding, open interest, and optional recent klines.
notes: Read-only Binance API.

tools.purpose: Fetch the current Binance USDⓈ-M symbol status and persist exact response bytes plus a retry-aware acquisition receipt.
notes: Read-only Binance API; writes only market_data_store acquisition receipts and raw payload BLOBs.
Emits current_snapshot_only and cannot create complete-history evidence or Archive Source Batches.

tools.purpose: Rank broad market candidates for follow-up inspection.
notes: Only answers which symbols to inspect next; never live action.

tools.purpose: Fetch recent aggregate trades for microstructure analysis.
notes: Can write raw-data artifacts; no trade facts.

tools.purpose: Infer liquidation-like zones from market data inputs.
notes: Analysis refs only; not a trading signal.

tools.purpose: Preview and route USDM order intent without placing an order.
notes: No exchange write.

tools.purpose: Place a USDM main entry or add-risk order after execution gates.
notes: Must be called through trade-flow execution for live strategy use.
When --exchange-runtime-db is present, records command/result refs in exchange_runtime_store; money truth remains in trade_event_store.

tools.purpose: Cancel regular or algo orders.
notes: Exchange write; local money state is recorded by trade-flow.
When --exchange-runtime-db is present, records command/result refs in exchange_runtime_store.

tools.purpose: Create stop, take-profit, or trailing protective legs.
notes: Exchange write; does not decide whether protection is strategically correct.
When --exchange-runtime-db is present, records command/result refs in exchange_runtime_store.

tools.purpose: Reduce or close an existing USDM position.
notes: No add-risk path; add risk belongs to order-place through trade-flow.
When --exchange-runtime-db is present, records command/result refs in exchange_runtime_store.
